strings.bipe_banner_unverified_body: Account created %1$s ago. Not in your contacts.
strings.bipe_banner_external: Account from another service. Bipe doesn't verify this person's name.
strings.bipe_banner_security_change: This account signed in on a new device. Its name hasn't been verified on that device yet.
strings.bipe_warning_money_request_body: Before you pay, check with the person another way. Scammers rush you.
strings.bipe_warning_reserved_name: This name is reserved for verified organisations.
strings.bipe_device_approval_never_for_others: Bipe never asks you to approve someone else's phone.
strings.bipe_badge_suspended_body: This account signed in on a new device. The seal comes back when the person verifies again on that device.
strings.bipe_badge_company_checked: Checked with the Receita Federal in
strings.bipe_badge_company_body: Bipe checked that the CNPJ is active at the Receita Federal and that this account belongs to the business. The seal does not vouch for every offer or charge. Before you pay, check the name your bank app shows.
strings.bipe_badge_company_revoked: This business is no longer verified.
strings.bipe_badge_company_revoked_not_active: This business is no longer verified. The CNPJ no longer shows as active at the Receita Federal.
strings.bipe_badge_company_suspended: This business's seal is suspended until Bipe checks the account again.
strings.bipe_warning_nickname_confirm_title: Is this the person you know?
strings.bipe_warning_nickname_confirm_body: You saved this contact as %1$s. The account is verified as %2$s. Is it the same person?
strings.bipe_pix_card_bank_name: Your bank will show the name %1$s. If you see another name, don't pay.
strings.bipe_pix_card_copied: Code copied. Paste it in your bank app.
strings.bipe_pix_card_status_sent: You marked it as sent. Waiting for %1$s to confirm receipt.
strings.bipe_warning_name_lookalike_emoji: This emoji can't go next to the name. It looks like a verification badge.
strings.bipe_scam_victim_body: Call your bank now and ask for a refund through MED. The sooner, the better your chance of getting the money back.
strings.bipe_settings_language_footer: Choose Portuguese or English in Bipe's settings on this phone.
strings.bipe_settings_share_presence_footer: If you turn this off, nobody sees you typing and you don't see others typing. Read receipts always stay on.
strings.bipe_about_steward: Data and servers stay in Brazil. Bipe is an experiment by Envisioning, a research institute.
strings.bipe_signup_handle_footer: People find you by your @ without seeing your number. You can choose it later.
strings.bipe_handle_too_short: Too short. Use at least %1$s characters.
strings.bipe_handle_too_long: Too long. Use at most %1$s characters.
strings.bipe_handle_invalid_characters: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, dots and underscores. Start with a letter or number and do not end with a dot.
strings.bipe_handle_taken: Someone already uses this @. Choose another.
strings.bipe_handle_screen_footer: People find you by your @ without seeing your number. After a change, wait 30 days before changing it again.
strings.bipe_handle_remove_body: Nobody can find you by @%1$s anymore, and your chats show that you no longer use it.
strings.bipe_messaging_everyone_body: People you don't know arrive as a chat request.
strings.bipe_messaging_verified_body: Accounts with a verified name can also message you. Until the badge is available, only your contacts can.
strings.bipe_messaging_contacts_body: People in a group or chat with you, people you invited and whoever invited you.
strings.bipe_error_invite_invalid: Couldn't use this invite. Ask the person who invited you for another.
strings.bipe_error_email_taken: This email is already on another Bipe account. Use a different email.
strings.bipe_error_password_weak: This password is too weak. Pick a longer or less obvious one.
strings.bipe_error_handle_cooldown: Wait 30 days between changes to your @.
strings.bipe_error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a bit and try again.
strings.bipe_error_unauthorized: Get back into your account to keep using Bipe on this device.
strings.bipe_error_network: Cannot reach Bipe. Check your connection and try again.
strings.bipe_error_attestation_invalid: We couldn't confirm this is the official Bipe app. Update the app and try again.
strings.bipe_error_attestation_failed: We couldn't check this phone with Apple. Check your connection and try again.
strings.bipe_signup_display_name_footer: People see this name in chats. You can change it later.
strings.bipe_start_chat_handle_not_found: We couldn't find @%1$s on Bipe. Check the @ with the person.
strings.bipe_start_chat_search_by_handle: On Bipe, you find people by their @. Ask them for it.
strings.bipe_profile_qr_footer: Anyone who points their camera at this code opens your Bipe profile.
strings.bipe_requests_row_body: You choose who to talk to
strings.bipe_request_unverified_body: This account's name hasn't been verified yet. If you aren't sure who it is, check another way before accepting.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_pix_key: The message appears to contain a Pix key. Before paying, check the request with the person another way.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_delivery_fee: Scammers often ask for a fee by link to release a delivery. Do not pay through the link. Check the tracking in the store's app or on the Correios site.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_lookalike_link: This link appears to imitate a bank, government office or company. Check in the app or on the site you already use.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_bank_alert: The message mentions unblocking an account, card or Pix. Check the notice in your bank's app.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_pix_code: The message has a Pix copy-and-paste code. Before you pay, check with the person another way and look at the name your bank shows.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_boleto: The message has a boleto code. Fake boletos are a common scam. Before you pay, check in your bank app who gets the money.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_receipt: The message mentions a payment receipt. A screenshot of a receipt does not prove payment. Check in your bank app that the money arrived.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_new_number: The message mentions a new number or account. Call the number you already have for the person to check.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_urgency: Rush and money requests show up a lot in scams. Before you do anything, check with the person another way.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_extortion: The message makes a threat and asks for money. Paying does not usually end the threat. Do not pay, and keep the messages. SaferNet helps for free, without asking your name: new.safernet.org.br/helpline
strings.bipe_scam_warning_remote_app: The message asks you to install an app. With an app like this, someone else can use your phone from far away, and banks do not ask for that. Do not install it. Call your bank on the number on your card.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_pin_request: The message asks for a PIN or a code. Nobody from Bipe asks for your PIN, not by message and not by phone call. Do not give it to anyone.
strings.bipe_signup_invite_required: To create your account, ask someone who already uses Bipe for an invite code.
strings.bipe_invite_already_signed_in: You already have an account. Invites are for people not on Bipe yet.
strings.bipe_invites_explainer: Invite your family first. Each invite works for one person and expires in 30 days.
strings.bipe_invites_other_device: Made on another device. Share it from there.
strings.bipe_invites_empty: Invite someone to chat with you on Bipe.
strings.bipe_invites_qr_footer: The other person points their phone camera at the code. After installing Bipe, they scan it again and the app opens with the invite filled in.
strings.bipe_trust_footer: Only you can see this profile.
strings.bipe_public_profile_toggle: Show my profile to people with the link
strings.bipe_public_profile_footer: People with your link see your name, photo and bio. Your profile doesn't appear in search. You can hide it whenever you want.
strings.bipe_public_profile_needs_handle: Choose a username first. Your profile link uses your @.
strings.bipe_public_profile_name_too_long: Name too long. Use at most %1$s characters.
strings.bipe_public_profile_bio_too_long: Bio too long. Use at most %1$s characters.
strings.bipe_public_profile_bio_too_many_lines: Use at most %1$s lines in the bio.
strings.bipe_public_profile_photo_invalid: That photo didn't work. Try another one.
strings.bipe_public_profile_not_verified: This profile doesn't verify the person's name
strings.bipe_trust_step_email_body: Open a link we send to your email.
strings.bipe_trust_step_pix_body: A R$ 0.01 Pix from your bank account verifies your name.
strings.bipe_trust_step_govbr_body: A signature with your gov.br account verifies your name.
strings.bipe_voice_transcript_unavailable: Couldn't transcribe. You can send the audio without text.
strings.bipe_stickers_empty_body: Save a sticker from a chat or make one from a photo.
strings.bipe_stickers_error_load: The stickers did not load. Try again.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_help: In WhatsApp, send the stickers to a group with only you in it. Then use Export chat, choose Attach media and save the file. Here, choose that file.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_help_folder_android: You can also choose the files in the WhatsApp Stickers folder.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_note: Imported stickers are stored on Bipe's server without end-to-end encryption. Only import images you can share.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_none: No new stickers in that file.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_failed: The import did not work. Try again.
strings.bipe_sticker_save_failed: Couldn't save the sticker. Try again.
strings.bipe_stickers_from_photo: Create a sticker from a photo
strings.bipe_contacts_intro: See which of your contacts are already on Bipe. The server only compares the numbers and stores none of them.
strings.bipe_contacts_denied: Bipe doesn't have access to your contacts. To allow it, open the app's settings on this phone.
strings.bipe_contacts_none: None of your contacts are on Bipe yet.
strings.bipe_contacts_invite: Invite people who are not here
strings.bipe_discovery_toggle: People who have my number can find me
strings.bipe_discovery_footer: Your number is never shown to anyone. Only people who already have you in their contacts can find you.
strings.bipe_phone_not_linked: Your number isn't linked to your account. Your contacts can't find you by it yet.
strings.bipe_groups_empty_body: Create a group to chat with family, friends or colleagues.
strings.bipe_self_chat_error: Couldn't open your notes. Try again.
strings.bipe_onboarding_point_scam: Checks look for scam signals in messages.
strings.bipe_onboarding_point_brazil: Data and servers stay in Brazil, under Brazilian law.
strings.bipe_onboarding_point_no_ads: No ads. Your data isn't for sale.
strings.bipe_signup_device_header: Start with your name. Your @ and email are optional.
strings.bipe_signup_email_optional_footer: Helps you get back into your account if you lose your phone. It doesn't appear on your profile.
strings.bipe_signup_terms_accept: I have read and accept the %1$s and the %2$s.
strings.bipe_signup_terms_required: To create your account, accept the Terms of use and the Privacy policy.
strings.bipe_terms_reaccept_body: To keep using Bipe, read and accept the Terms of use and the Privacy policy.
strings.bipe_terms_reaccept_failed: We could not save your acceptance. Try again.
strings.bipe_pin_create_body: Choose a PIN with %1$s numbers. It locks the app and helps protect account recovery.
strings.bipe_pin_never_asked: Nobody from Bipe asks for your PIN. Not by message, not by phone call.
strings.bipe_pin_mismatch: The two PINs do not match. Try again.
strings.bipe_pin_problem_repeated_digit: Repeated digits are easy to guess. Pick another PIN.
strings.bipe_pin_problem_sequence: Sequences are easy to guess. Pick another PIN.
strings.bipe_pin_problem_date: This looks like a date, and dates are easy to guess. Pick another PIN.
strings.bipe_pin_wrong: That PIN doesn't match. Attempts left: %1$s.
strings.bipe_pin_blocked_body: The PIN locked after %1$s wrong tries. Create a new one with your recovery email.
strings.bipe_pin_change_biometric_reason: Confirm it is you to change the PIN.
strings.bipe_fallback_body: Choose a way to get back into your account if you lose your phone. Without one, you may lose access to your account.
strings.bipe_fallback_email_body: We send you a link. With the link and your PIN, the account comes back after %1$s hours.
strings.bipe_fallback_guardians_body: People you confirmed in person approve getting back into your account. Then there is a %1$s-hour wait.
strings.bipe_fallback_recovery_key_body: The key also brings back your old messages. Nobody at Bipe will ask for it.
strings.bipe_fallback_reminder: You have no way back into your account yet if you lose your phone.
strings.bipe_email_footer: Use it to get back into your account or create a new PIN. It doesn't appear on your profile.
strings.bipe_email_sent: We sent a link to %1$s. Open it to confirm.
strings.bipe_email_link_invalid: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one in the app.
strings.bipe_error_email_unavailable: We cannot send email right now. Try again later.
strings.bipe_recovery_qr_body: Open Bipe on the old phone and point this phone's camera at the QR code that shows there.
strings.bipe_recovery_qr_never_from_others: Bipe never asks you to scan a QR code that someone else sent.
strings.bipe_recovery_token_found: Your account came with this phone's backup. Enter your PIN to sign in.
strings.bipe_recovery_email_body: Open the link sent to your recovery email and enter your PIN. Then wait %1$s hours.
strings.bipe_recovery_email_sent: If this email belongs to a Bipe account, the link arrives in a few minutes. Open it on this phone.
strings.bipe_recovery_guardians_body: One guardian approves on their phone. If you have two or more, two must approve. Then your PIN and a %1$s-hour wait.
strings.bipe_recovery_cpf_body: Verify your CPF again. Then your PIN and a %1$s-hour wait.
strings.bipe_recovery_waiting_body: Your account comes back to this phone on %1$s. Your other devices got a notice and can cancel.
strings.bipe_recovery_waiting_pin_body: Your new PIN takes effect on %1$s. Your other devices got a notice and can cancel.
strings.bipe_recovery_ready: Your account is on this phone.
strings.bipe_recovery_pin_ready: Done. Your new PIN works now.
strings.bipe_recovery_history_note: To see old messages, approve this phone on a connected device or use your recovery key.
strings.bipe_recovery_cancelled: Getting back into the account was cancelled on one of your devices.
strings.bipe_error_recovery_invalid: You can't continue from here anymore. Start again.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_title: Your account is moving to a new device
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_email: Someone used your recovery email to move your account to another device. If it was not you, cancel now. If nobody cancels, the account opens on that device on %1$s.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_guardian: Your guardians approved moving your account to another device. If it was not you, cancel now. If nobody cancels, the account opens on that device on %1$s.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_cpf: Someone verified your CPF to move your account to another device. If it was not you, cancel now. If nobody cancels, the account opens on that device on %1$s.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_pin_reset: Someone asked for a new PIN for your account. If it was not you, cancel now. If nobody cancels, the new PIN takes effect on %1$s.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_token: Your account signed in on a new device with the iCloud or Google backup and your PIN. If it was not you, change your PIN and sign out of the devices you do not know.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_cancelled: Cancelled. Your account stays on your devices only.
strings.bipe_mail_recovery_subject: Your link to get back into Bipe
strings.bipe_mail_recovery_body:
Someone asked to get back into your Bipe account with this email.

If it was you, open this link on the new phone, with Bipe installed:
%1$s

The link works for %2$s minutes. After the link, the app asks for your 8-digit PIN and there is a %3$s-hour wait. Your other devices get a notice and can cancel.

If it was not you, ignore this email and do not share the link with anyone.
strings.bipe_mail_verify_body:
Open this link to confirm that this email is yours:
%1$s

The link works for %2$s hours. Once you confirm it, this email lets you get back into your Bipe account if you lose your phone.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_subject: A change to your Bipe account
strings.bipe_mail_notice_recovery_started:
Someone asked to move your Bipe account to another device. If nobody cancels, this happens on %1$s.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices and cancel.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_pin_reset_started:
Someone asked for a new PIN for your Bipe account. If nobody cancels, the new PIN takes effect on %1$s.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices and cancel.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_new_device:
Your Bipe account signed in on a new device with the iCloud or Google backup and your PIN.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices, change your PIN and sign out of the devices you do not know.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_pin_changed:
The 8-digit PIN of your Bipe account changed.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices and change the PIN.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_email_removed:
This email no longer gets you back into your Bipe account.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices and check the recovery email.
strings.bipe_mail_waitlist_body:
You joined the Bipe waitlist. It is your turn now.

Open this link on your phone to install Bipe and make your account:
%1$s

The invite works for %2$s days and for one account. When you use the invite, or when it expires, Bipe deletes your email from the list.

If you did not ask to join the list, ignore this email.
strings.bipe_mail_footer: This email is from Bipe. Do not reply, because nobody reads this mailbox. Bipe never asks for your PIN by email.
strings.bipe_trust_identity_body: The badge shows the verified name. It doesn't guarantee that a message is safe.
strings.bipe_trust_contact_body: You confirmed this person in person. Name verification is a separate check.
strings.bipe_trust_contact_unconfirmed: You haven't confirmed this person in person yet
strings.bipe_trust_change_confirm_action: Confirm with the person through another channel before sending money.
strings.bipe_trust_lifecycle_unknown: We couldn't check this account's changes yet.
strings.bipe_trust_warning_absence_body: Even without a warning, confirm a money request with the person through another channel.
strings.bipe_pix_check_nothing_found: We couldn't find a Pix code or key here.
strings.bipe_pix_check_code_dynamic: Charge code. The recipient's bank confirms the amount and the name when you pay.
strings.bipe_pix_check_code_bad_crc: This code was changed or is incomplete. Do not pay with it.
strings.bipe_pix_check_code_malformed: This Pix code is incomplete. Do not pay with it.
strings.bipe_pix_check_name_hint: The person who made the code entered this name. Check the name in your bank's app before paying.
strings.bipe_pix_check_bank_name: Before paying, check the recipient's name in your bank's app.
strings.bipe_pix_check_private: The check runs only on your phone.

strings.bipe_catalog_photo_failed: Couldn't save the photo. Choose a smaller photo and try again.

strings.bipe_agenda_pick_template: What kind of business do you run?
strings.bipe_agenda_add_person: Add someone who provides the service
strings.bipe_agenda_template_hint: These durations and hours are suggestions. Adjust them before publishing.
strings.bipe_agenda_setup_done: Schedule published. Customers can book from your profile.
strings.bipe_agenda_walk_in_hint: A customer without a Bipe account gets no reminder.
strings.bipe_agenda_close_today_body: Existing bookings stay in the schedule. Reschedule or cancel with each customer.
strings.bipe_agenda_close_today_message: I cannot keep our appointment today. Can we find another time?
strings.bipe_agenda_no_slots: No free times on this day. Choose another day.
strings.bipe_agenda_status_held: Time held for a few minutes
strings.bipe_agenda_error_slot_taken: That time was just booked. Choose another.
strings.bipe_agenda_error_hold_expired: The hold expired. Choose a time again.
strings.bipe_agenda_error_too_many_open: You have reached this business’s limit for open bookings.
strings.bipe_agenda_error_outside_notice: That time is too soon. Choose a later time.
strings.bipe_agenda_error_outside_horizon: Bookings are not open for that date yet. Choose an earlier date.
strings.bipe_agenda_error_not_published: This business has not published its schedule yet.
strings.bipe_agenda_error_cancel_window: The time to cancel in the app has passed. Talk to the service provider in the chat.
strings.bipe_agenda_error_save: Could not save the booking. Try again.

strings.bipe_agenda_push_moved: New time at %1$s: %2$s, %3$s. Check in Bipe.

strings.bipe_settings_privacy_summary_verified: Contacts and verified accounts can message you

strings.bipe_linked_devices_footer: Open chat.bipe.net.br on the computer and scan the code with this phone.
strings.bipe_linked_devices_empty: No other device is linked to your account.
strings.bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_body: The device leaves your account and stops getting your chats. On the page that opens, confirm the sign-out.
strings.bipe_linked_devices_sign_out_biometric: Confirm it's you to sign out a device.
strings.bipe_linked_devices_error: Couldn't load the devices. Try again.
strings.bipe_link_computer_warning_title: This computer will get access to all your chats
strings.bipe_link_computer_warning_body: Anyone at the computer can read your messages and send messages as you. Only continue if the computer is yours and you opened chat.bipe.net.br on it.
strings.bipe_link_computer_warning_scam: If someone asked you to scan this code, stop. It's a scam.
strings.bipe_link_computer_biometric: Confirm it's you to link a computer.
strings.bipe_link_computer_consent_hint: Check the browser, the IP and the place. If it is your computer, approve on the page below.
strings.bipe_link_computer_error_sign_in: Bipe couldn't open the approval page. Try again.
strings.bipe_link_computer_not_supported: This phone can't link a computer right now.
strings.bipe_link_computer_needs_pin: To link a computer, create your %1$s-digit PIN first.
strings.bipe_privacy_requests_hide_photos_footer: Photos from people you don't know show only after you accept.
strings.bipe_privacy_number_linked: Your number is linked to your account
strings.bipe_privacy_number_not_linked: Your number isn't linked to your account
strings.bipe_privacy_presence_footer: If you turn this off, nobody sees when you are online or typing. You stop seeing it for others too.
strings.bipe_privacy_read_receipts_footer: On Bipe, people see when you read their messages, and you see when they read yours. You can't turn this off.
strings.bipe_privacy_export_footer: The file contains your Bipe account data. It doesn't include the contents of your chats.
strings.bipe_privacy_export_biometric: Confirm it's you to download your data.
strings.bipe_privacy_export_error: Couldn't download your data. Try again.
strings.bipe_privacy_what_bipe_keeps: What Bipe keeps and for how long
strings.bipe_notifications_whole_group: When someone mentions the whole group
strings.bipe_chats_media_quality: Quality of photos and videos you send
strings.bipe_chats_show_media_private: Only in chats and closed groups
strings.bipe_chats_live_location_footer: How far you need to move before your live location updates on the map.
strings.bipe_profile_display_name_footer: People you chat with see it.
strings.bipe_notifications_tone_error: Couldn't use this sound. Try another.
strings.bipe_notifications_mismatch_body: Some choices you made before do not show on this screen, but they still apply. If you continue, Bipe may change some of them.
strings.bipe_chats_live_location_precise: For live location to work, turn on Precise Location for Bipe in iPhone Settings.
strings.bipe_chats_live_location_permission: For live location to work, keep precise location on for Bipe. To change it, open %1$s.
strings.bipe_chats_empty_body: Ask someone you know for their @ to start a conversation.
strings.bipe_notifications_permission_body: You can change this in this phone's settings.
strings.bipe_chat_sender_device_unconfirmed: This message came from an unconfirmed device
strings.bipe_chat_sender_keys_changed: The sender's encryption keys have changed
strings.bipe_microphone_permission_body: To record audio, allow the microphone in Bipe's settings on this phone.
strings.bipe_camera_permission_body: To use the camera in Bipe, allow access in the app's settings on this phone.
strings.bipe_report_message_reason: Why do you want to report this message?
strings.bipe_report_message_body: Your server's team receives the reason you write and the message ID.
strings.bipe_help_problem_description: Tell us what happened, what you tried to do and what you expected to happen.
strings.bipe_help_report_sent_body: The Bipe team will read it and reply in the Bipe Support chat.
strings.bipe_help_problem_language: Describe the problem in your own words.
strings.bipe_chat_message_no_access: You don't have access to this message
strings.bipe_invite_code_body: Ask the person who invited you for the code.
strings.bipe_waitlist_body: Bipe is opening up slowly. Ask someone who already uses it for an invite, or join the waitlist and we'll let you know.
strings.bipe_waitlist_done: You're on the list. We'll email you.
strings.bipe_signup_signin_failed: Your account was created, but signing in didn't work. Try again.
strings.bipe_recovery_beta_body: For people who joined the beta with an email and a password.
strings.bipe_notifications_prompt_title: %1$s will reply. Want to know right away?
strings.bipe_notifications_prompt_title_generic: Want to know right away when someone replies?
strings.bipe_notifications_prompt_body: Bipe tells you when a new message arrives. You can change this later in Settings.
strings.bipe_handle_prompt_body: With an @, people can find you on Bipe.
strings.bipe_support_open_failed: Couldn't open support right now. Try again.
strings.bipe_support_room_topic: A chat with the Bipe team. The team reads what you write here in a support tool. Photos and files stay on the Bipe server.
strings.bipe_support_welcome: Hi! This is where you talk to the Bipe team. Tell us what happened or what you want to see in the app. We answer in this chat.
strings.bipe_support_report_received: We got your problem report. The team will read it and answer in this chat.
strings.bipe_support_already_open: You already have a chat with support. Continue here.
